test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Dispose** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Dispose **means to get rid of or throw away something. (किसी चीज़ से छुटकारा पाना या फेंकना) • **Example**: *She decided to dispose of old furniture and donate it to charity instead of keeping it in storage.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the given blank because it fits the context of completing a task or activity. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Show **means to display or present something. (कुछ प्रदर्शित या प्रस्तुत करना) • **Disturb **means to interrupt or interfere with something. (किसी चीज़ में बाधा डालना या हस्तक्षेप करना) • **Finish **means to complete or conclude or to reach the end of a competition. (किसी प्रतियोगिता को पूरा करना या समाप्त करना या अंत तक पहुँचना) 54:Tb38, The correct answer is: **Sanitation**
